decision: GitHub data is pulled read-only via `gh api` CLI, supports GitHub Enterprise via GH_HOST, and runs as a standalone Node.js script — not inside the Next.js server.
key_insight: GitHub data is pulled read-only via `gh api` CLI, supports GitHub Enterprise via GH_HOST, and runs as a standalone Node.js script — not inside the Next.js server.
alternatives_considered: GitHub REST API called directly from Next.js API routes
GitHub App OAuth for organization-wide install
rejected_reason: API routes running sync would make the web server stateful and slow
Organization-wide install violates the local-first, no-setup-required principle
